tweets.text:
Perfectionism is just fear in a tuxedo.

It whispers: "Wait until it's ready."

It's never ready. Ship it anyway.

The gap between where you are and where you want to be...

Is filled with imperfect action.
Not perfect plans.

Every expert was once a beginner who refused to quit.

The only difference: they started before they felt ready.

You can too.

Progress > Perfection

Save this carousel. Read it when you're stuck.

Then take one messy step forward.
